subject: Checkout blackout: impact window verification and remedial offer
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@cartflow.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>; Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 29 May 2029 23:12:00 -0700
Subject: Checkout failure — large burst of 500s between 22:30–22:46 PT

Hi Logan / Laura,

We saw a customer-visible checkout blackout on our production tenant (cartflow-prod) last night. Between ~22:30 and 22:46 PT a large fraction of checkout attempts returned 500s; we lost ~1,800 checkout attempts and ~430 completed orders failed. This impacted live traffic and a handful of high-value customers.

Attached is a short sample of 500 responses and a list of representative orderIDs. Can you confirm whether this is considered an availability incident under our SLA? We need:
- Formal confirmation of the impacted window
- If eligible, an estimate of compensatory credit and timeline
- A postmortem / RCA date so we can show our stakeholders

We’re available to jump on a triage call if helpful.

Attachments: checkout-500s-sample.txt

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Patel
Ops Lead, Cartflow Inc
ops@cartflow.com
+1 415-555-0182

From: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@cartflow.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 May 2029 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Checkout failure — large burst of 500s between 22:30–22:46 PT

Samir — thanks for the report and the sample. I'm sorry for the disruption.

Quick plan:
1) I've looped in Laura (Customer Success) and Diego (Infra) to coordinate evidence collection and remediation.
2) Can you attach a raw trace bundle (gzip of traces + request IDs) and the list of failed orderIDs — that will speed validation.
3) We will preliminarily scope the candidate impact window and return a provisional credit estimate within 48 hours; final calculation follows the telemetry reconciliation.

If it's ok, we'll pull the tenant's raw traces and span logs now (we'll share the archive to your Drive link). Please confirm permission for Redwood to retrieve and bundle traces (we will follow your redaction instructions). I'm attaching the SLA claim form to standardize information intake.

Next steps from us within 24 hours: short impact window estimate and a proposed time for an RCA meeting.

Logan Wright
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
logan@redwood.com

From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>; Samir Patel <samir@cartflow.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 May 2029 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Checkout failure — large burst of 500s between 22:30–22:46 PT

Thanks Samir — can you confirm the earliest and latest orderIDs (and correlate to request IDs if possible)? I ran a quick telemetry pass across regional ingress and saw a short spike in request queue depth and several kV cache evictions around 22:31:08 PT. That pattern can produce 5xx errors during a brief amplification.

Operational asks from Redwood infra team:
- Raw trace bundle (all spans covering 22:25–22:50 PT)
- Any client-side retry patterns or unusual payload shapes you observed
- If you can, allow us to snapshot internal agent logs — we'll redact secrets and share a digest.

I've attached a small note with exact trace bundle instructions so collection matches our processing pipeline. If what I described shows up in the traces we'll propose proportional (apportioned) credits rather than blanket refunds since a subset of requests succeeded.

—Diego
Diego Fernandez
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference

From: Samir Patel <samir@cartflow.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>; Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 May 2029 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Checkout failure — large burst of 500s between 22:30–22:46 PT

Logan / Diego — attaching the raw trace bundle now (raw-traces-20290529.tar.gz) and the full list of orderIDs we saw fail. We redacted PII per our policy.

OrderIDs (representative): CF-982311, CF-982317, CF-982321, CF-982459, CF-982596, ...

We need an ETA on the provisional window confirmation and whether Redwood will apply a credit while you complete the reconciliation. Our finance team is asking for a date to present to the CFO.

Attachments: raw-traces-20290529.tar.gz

Samir

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@cartflow.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 May 2029 11:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Checkout failure — large burst of 500s between 22:30–22:46 PT

Hi Samir — thanks for the bundle. I pulled an initial telemetry slice and propose the candidate impact window: 2029-05-29T22:31:10-07:00 through 2029-05-29T22:46:20-07:00 (UTC-7). During that interval we see elevated 5xx ratios and a spike in upstream queueing correlated with the traces you provided.

A couple of important items:
- We will preserve the trace bundle and system snapshots for 30 days to support any audit; please do not purge on your side until reconciliation completes.
- Based on preliminary sampling it looks like ~11% of checkout traffic in that window experienced unrecoverable failures; subject to full reconciliation we expect a proportional credit calculation.

Proposed remedial path:
1) Redwood issues a provisional credit estimate within 48 hours (by 2029-06-01T11:00:00-07:00).
2) Final reconciliation complete within 10 business days following evidence review.
3) We’ll schedule a 60-minute postmortem with your ops + product + SRE teams in the week of 2029-06-03 — please share preferred times.

I’m attaching here the completed intake form template and a DocuSign link to accept a provisional credit offer once we’ve agreed on the candidate window.

DocuSign: https://redwood.docusign.com/agree/RC-20290529-cartflow

Hannah Schmitt
SLO & Reliability Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@cartflow.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 May 2029 12:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Checkout failure — large burst of 500s between 22:30–22:46 PT

Samir — appreciate the quick turnaround on traces and the order list.

Recap and next steps: 
- Candidate impact window: 2029-05-29 22:31:10–22:46:20 PT (Hannah's preliminary finding).
- Provisional credit estimate: Redwood will provide an initial pro-rata estimate by 2029-06-01 11:00 PT; final calculation after reconciliation (<=10 business days).
- Postmortem: we’ll propose 3 time slots for the week of 2029-06-03; Laura will coordinate with your team on scheduling.
- Evidence handling: Redwood will keep the raw traces and logs and share a sanitized digest; please keep your copies for 30 days.

If that plan looks good, please reply "confirm" and we'll route the provisional credit offer for DocuSign once we land on a number. Again, sincere apologies for the disruption — we’ll prioritize the RCA and remediation.

—Logan
Logan Wright
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
